name: The mistaken love of a leeches appetite
source:
You have a crush on this dude, and after hanging out with him at the dinner you realize he's into you, maybe a bit too much?

[From [url=https://lostiolite00.itch.io/the-mistaken-love-of-a-leeches-appetite]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你暗恋着这个家伙，而在与他共进晚餐、相处一番之后，你意识到他对你也有意思——只是这份迷恋似乎有点过了头？

[摘自[url=https://lostiolite00.itch.io/the-mistaken-love-of-a-leeches-appetite]itch.io[/url]]
